narrative_purpose: The cold-open figure grounds the whole chapter: everything the reader sees of the Metkayina world is resting on a reef, a floor made by living organisms rather than laid down as inert rock.
subject: A Metkayina village of woven bulbous pod-dwellings hung from the thick aerial stilt-roots of giant mangrove-like trees, above a still turquoise lagoon. In front of it a low stepped terraced reef barrier breaks a distant line of ocean swell. Through the clear shallow water the reef floor is legible: branching and mounded coral-like growths, encrusting sessile life, and pale accreted rock. A couple of slender blue Na'vi walk the elevated walkways; one child dives from a platform toward the bright lagoon floor.
scene: A sheltered reef lagoon on Pandora enclosed by an atoll barrier, open ocean beyond fading to teal haze, gentle morning light.
camera: Wide lateral establishing view at a low aerial angle, village to the left, lagoon and its visible living floor across the centre, barrier arcing behind.
light: Cool teal daylight shafts into shallow water, faint cyan bioluminescence along the submerged reef life, one small warm amber glow from a dwelling interior.
palette: Ocean teal and void indigo dominant, cyan reef glow, a single restrained ember-amber accent.
style: Hand-painted speculative-biology naturalist plate, observed and calm rather than dramatic.
detail_level: High detail on foreground pods, roots and the visible reef floor; distant ocean and barrier dissolve into haze, with plain dark water beside key features for later labels.
composition: Dwellings and roots occupy the left third, the reef floor reads clearly through the central shallows, the stepped barrier sits in an uncluttered background band with open haze above.
